segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: On behalf of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office, I would like to express

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: our sincere appreciation to the Committee on Appropriations, headed by its

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: chairperson

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: Honorable Congresswoman Mikaela Suansing and, of course, Senior Vice Chairperson

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: Honorable Albert S. Garcia for giving us the opportunity to present the PCSO's

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: proposed budget and programs for the coming fiscal year we are honored to

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: appear before this committee and to share not only our budget requirements

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: but more importantly how we intend to translate these resources into

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: meaningful and tangible benefits for the Filipino people. The PCSO remains firmly

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: committed to fulfilling its mandate under Republic Act No. 1169, as

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: amended to generate and provide funds for health programs medical assistance

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: and services and charitable activities of national character. Every peso entrusted to PCSO

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: carries with it a responsibility to serve. Our budget, therefore, is not simply a financial

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: plan. It is an instrument for expanding access to health care, strengthening our assistance

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: program, bringing essential services closer to communities, and ensuring that our operations

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: remain efficient, accountable, and responsive. PCSO continues to strengthen its financial

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: performance, governance, responsible gaming initiatives, and delivery of charitable services.

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: We recognize, however, that the needs of our people continue to grow. This makes prudent

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: resource allocation, operational efficiency, and sustained support for our programs even

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: more critical. Today, we respectfully present our proposed budget, our priorities, and

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: the outcomes we seek to achieve. We assure the Committee that we will continue to exercise

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: the high standards of fiscal responsibility, transparency, accountability, and good governance

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: in the use of public resources. We look forward to the guidance and support of the Committee

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: as we work together toward a budget that will enable PCSO to reach more beneficiaries and

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: create greater impact for the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: Once again, our deepest appreciation to the distinguished members of the Committee

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes
segments.text: on Appropriations. Thank you very much, and good afternoon. And for our report, may I

segments.speaker: PCSO Chairperson Judge Felix P. Reyes

segments.speaker: Rep. Mikaela Angela B. Suansing

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Thank you very much, Chairman, for your presentation.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Good afternoon, Honorable Albert Garcia, Senior Vice Chair, and Honorable Members of the House

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Committee on Appropriations.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: We begin this briefing by recalling the mandate that guides the work of the Philippine Charity

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Sweepstakes Office.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office is the principal government agency for raising

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: and providing funds for health programs, medical assistance and services, and charities

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: of national character, through the holding and conduct of sweepstakes horse races, lotteries,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: and similar activities.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: This mandate is at the heart of every peso that PCSO generates and every peso that we allocate.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Our financial performance is therefore not only about revenues, expenditures, and targets.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: It is ultimately about our capacity to provide meaningful assistance to the Filipino people.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Let us now proceed to the budgetary highlights and major thrusts, including plans, programs, and strategies to be undertaken by the PCSO in 2027.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: First is the distribution of landing craft vessels, or LCVs, to coastal provinces and provinces with coastal municipalities.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: This initiative aims to address the unique challenges faced by geographically isolated

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: and coastal communities, particularly in accessing health care and emergency services.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Second, the donation of medical equipment to beneficiary entities. This is intended to strengthen the capacity of hospitals and health care facilities by providing much-needed equipment.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: The desired impact is improved healthcare, better patient care, and greater access to essential medical services.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Third, PCSO's participation in the government initiative to establish a radiation oncology center.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: This initiative seeks to improve access to cancer diagnosis, treatment, and specialized care,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: while helping reduce the financial and health burdens of cancer on Filipino families.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Fourth, increasing PCSO revenues through the development of new games and betting platforms.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: This is critical.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: to sustaining PCSO's capacity to fund its various health and charitable programs.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: By responsibly expanding our revenue-generating activities and responding to changing consumer

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: preferences, we aim to increase the resources available for medical assistance,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: health programs, and other charitable initiatives. Finally, strengthen public service delivery

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: through digitalized processes and the successful transfer of operations to the PCSO Corporate

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Center in San Marcelino, Manila. Digitalization is intended to make our services more accessible,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: efficient, transparent, and responsive. At the same time,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: the successful transfer to the corporate center will provide a more integrated and efficient

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: environment for our operations. Next slide, please.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: For our operational

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: highlights from 2024 to 2026. First, the Medical Assistance Program remains one of PCSO's most

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: significant and direct expressions of its mandate to provide meaningful medical assistance to

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Filipinos in need. From 2024 to the first semester of 2026, PCSO provided 8.13 billion in assistance

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: to 681,999 beneficiaries. In 2024, PCSO assisted 326,482 beneficiaries with 3.24 billion.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: In 2025, despite a 28% decline in beneficiaries to 236,217, assistance slightly increased to 3.25

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: billion. This translates to a substantial increase in average assistance per beneficiary, reflecting

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: PCSO's focus on greater efficacy and efficiency.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: The focus is not merely on the number of beneficiaries served, but

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: on maximizing the impact of every peso allocated to medical assistance.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: This is particularly significant given PCSO's continuing contribution to government's health agenda, including its increased remittance to

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: the universal

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: health care program. Despite this higher

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: financial obligation to broader national health system, PCSO continues to provide substantial

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: direct assistance to patients and their families. Moreover, pursuant to the expressed desire

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: of the members of the House Committee on Appropriations,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: PCSO has expanded its financial assistance to include professional fees for qualified patients.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: This makes the assistance more comprehensive, responsive, and patient-centered, helping families meet the full cost of necessary medical care.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Next, the Institutional Partnership Program shows a positive trend, with beneficiaries doubling from 19 in 2024 to 38 in 2025, accompanied by an increase in assistance from 12 million to 24.6 million.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: By the first semester of 2026, another 19 beneficiaries had already been assisted.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: A particularly strong growth is seen in the Medical Transport Vehicle Donation Program.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Beneficiaries increased from 431 in 2024 to 1,090 in 2025, while assistance increased from 913.7 million to 2.48 billion.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: This reflects

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: PCSO's intensified efforts to bring emergency and medical transport services closer to communities.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: As of July 31, 2026, PCSO has distributed 154 PTVs to complete the 100% distribution of PTVs in provinces, cities, and municipalities.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: The Medical Equipment Donation Program, on the other hand, shows increased assistance funding from 20.5 million in 2024 to 22 million in 2025 and

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: already reached 154.58 million in the first semester of 2026, indicating a significant acceleration in equipment support.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Meanwhile, the Outpatient Services and Multi-Specialty Clinic continues to expand its reach, with beneficiaries increasing from 7,383 in 2024 to 9,416

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: in 2025 and another 8,440 beneficiaries already served in the first half of 2026.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: For the financial highlights for 2024 to the first semester of 2026,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: PCSO's total revenues from its major games increased by 4.02 percent from 62.35 billion

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: in 2024 to 64.86 billion in 2025. The growth was primarily driven by STL which increased by 11.99

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: percent and the National Instant Sweepstakes Program, which grew by 20 percent. For the first

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: semester of 2026, PCSO generated 32.68 billion. Overall, the revenue trend remains positive and

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: resilient with STL serving as the main growth driver. The next slide reflects the comparative

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: We now proceed to the significant accomplishments of PCSO

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: for the year 2025 and the first semester of 2026,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: highlighting actual performance against planned targets.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: This covers five key areas, gross revenues, PTV distribution,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: medical assistance, institutional partnerships, and WLA certification.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: First, on gross revenues, in 2025, PCSO targeted 68.64 billion

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: and achieved 64.86 billion, or 94.5% of the target.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: The shortfall was largely due to opportunity losses arising from several calamities

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: and weather disturbances throughout 2025,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: which affected gaming operations and revenue-generating activities.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Second, for PTV,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: distribution, PCSO significantly exceeded its 2025 target of 500 patient transport vehicles,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: distributing 1,090 PTVs, or 218% of target.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: For 2026, against a target of 258 PTVs,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: 154 PTVs have already been distributed as of July 31, 2026.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Third, for the medical assistance,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: PCSO targeted 3.302 billion in 2025 and released 3.245 billion,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: benefiting 236,217 patients, or approximately 98.3% of the annual financial target.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: The slight shortfall reflects the timing and actual utilization of assistance during the year.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: PCSO has allocated 3.65 billion for the medical assistance program.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: As of June 30, 2026,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: 1.64 billion has already been released,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: benefiting 118,400 patients.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: For the institutional partnership program,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: PCSO exceeded its 2025 target of 30 partner agencies

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: by establishing partnerships with 38 agencies.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong

segments.text: 19 partner agencies have already been

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: 30, representing 63% of the target

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: as of the reporting period.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Finally, for the World Lottery Association

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: certifications, PCSO successfully

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: attained World Lottery Association Level 3 Responsible Gaming Certification in 2025,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: exceeding its target of obtaining Level 3 certification.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Responsible Gaming ensures that revenue generation is pursued in a manner that is ethical, sustainable, and socially responsible.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: For 2026, PCSO is pursuing World Lottery Association Security Control Standard 2024 Level 1 Certification,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: which focuses on strengthening the security and integrity of the corporation's system, information, critical operations, and security controls.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: We now move on to the other significant accomplishments of PCSO for the year 2025 and the first semester of 2026.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: First is a 100% distribution of patient transport vehicles to provinces, cities, and municipalities.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Second is the donation of portable, AI-capable x-ray machines and various medical equipment to beneficiary entities amounting to P176 million.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: And the distribution of charity mobility aids, assistive devices, rescue devices, and evacuation kits

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: to various LGUs amounting to P348.6 million under the Corporate Social Responsibility Program.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: We now go to the status of PCSO's remittances under the Universal Healthcare Program covering 2025 to the first semester of 2026.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: For 2025, PCSO remitted a total amount of approximately 2.57 billion.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: For 2026, covering the first two quarters, first quarter is 651.47 million and second quarter is 690.67 million.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Combining 2025 remittances and the first semester of 2026, the total amount due and remitted is 3.914 billion pesos.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: It is important to highlight that the amount due and the amount remitted are exactly the same for each period, indicating 100% remittance of the amounts reflected in the table.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: For the next slide, we present PCSO's contribution to the National Treasury through taxes, dividends, and other remittances covering the period 2021 to the first semester of 2026.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: This table shows PCSO's contributions to the National Treasury through taxes, dividends, and mandatory contributions from 2021 to 2025, with the first semester of 2026 also reflected.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: For the last full five years, 2021 to 2025, PCSO contributed a total of approximately 101.29 billion to the National Government.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Taxes accounted for the largest share at 79.04 billion, followed by dividends of 9.93 billion and universal healthcare contributions of 9.53 billion.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Overall, PCSO's total contributions increased from 14.56 billion in 2021 to 21.85 billion in 2025.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: representing a 50.1% increase.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: As of June 30, 2026,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: PCSO has already remitted an additional 11.06 billion, bringing the total contributions

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: reflected in the table to 112.35 billion. These figures demonstrate PCSO's significant

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: and sustained contribution to government revenues, healthcare, and national programs.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: In closing, our report demonstrates PCSO's continued financial resilience, operating

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: performance, and commitment to its charitable mandate. Despite changing economic conditions,

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: PCSO continues to generate revenues, provide support for the health and welfare of the

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Filipino people, and contribute significantly to the national government.

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: Sa bawat taya, may kawanggawa, and that is the greater purpose of

segments.speaker: PCSO Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza P. Inciong
segments.text: PCSO.

segments.text: To transform hope into help, to turn revenues into meaningful assistance, and to ensure

segments.text: [unclear] procurement and feasibility of

segments.text: Fiscal Year [unclear] 27 strategic [unclear] ng

segments.text: PCSO LCVs o mga landing craft vessels sa

segments.text: [unclear] legal na mandato ng militar sa Coast Guard,

segments.text: mga sasakyang pandagat ng PCSO,

segments.text: kabuuang badyet, alokasyon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: mga gastos sa pagpapanatili,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Chairman, good afternoon.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: As you know, all the cities of our country have ambulances.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Ang iba pong mga bayan ay marami pong isla.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: So, ang kanilang mga ambulansya ay hindi rin po makakatawid.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: So, it will be just inside the municipal island or the area nila.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: So, kasama rin po sa aming mandate for providing medical mobility,

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: sa aming mandate namin to provide charities of national character,

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: ang gawin pong effective yung pinamigay namin mga ambulanses or PTP na tinatawag.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: And yun po ang nakita namin na very effective way to,

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: hindi na po bababa kasi ang pasahir, ang pasyente.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Kung maalala nyo po, isinasakay pa po mula sa ambulansya, inililipat yan sa ambulance.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: So, kung maalan po yan, magkakaproblema pa pa pag binubuhat yan.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: So, ang aming intention is to have this door-to-door na po,

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: yung ambulansya na po mismo, ang isasakay ito at dadali na po sa paglilipat ng hospital na mas equipped kung hindi po kaya.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: At meron po kami, ito naman po ay the LGUs will have to secure licenses from Marina once they receive this.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: At we are starting with around 10 muna.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: And then, we will proceed from there for the next years naman po ang pagbigay namin.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Kasi hindi naman din po lahat.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: And by the way, this will be for the provincial governments po dahil medyo iba po ang maintenance nito.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: So, we will be giving this to the provincial governments for them to schedule kung alin po yung mga bayan nila na mas nangangailangan ito.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: And then, doon po sa aming procurement.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: [unclear] whoever wins the procurement will maintain it for the first three years.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Including the training of the personnel na gagapit po nito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: That's good to hear po, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: On equity in patient-transferred vehicle naman po, distribution and AI X-ray deployment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Nag-report po kasi ang PCSO ng 100% distribution ng patient-transferred vehicles.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: units na nagkakahalaga po ng around 3.73 billion.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: At pamimigay ng 197 million worth of medical equipment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Tulad niya po nung na-mention ko na AI capable portable X-rays.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Ano po ang criteria ng PCSO sa pagpili ng mga probinsya or hospital na nakatanggap po nito?

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: At tinitiyak ba natin or matitiyak pa po ba ng ating PCSO na ang...

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: mga geographically isolated and disadvantaged areas or GIDAs

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: ang nauuna sa pamimigay kumpara sa mga urbanized LGUs na may kakayanan naman bumili ng kanilang ambulansya?

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Number one po, we give dun po sa, siyempre po, siyan mas nangangailangan.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: At sila po ang nakakaalam nun.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Ang mga hospitals ng LGU ang mas nakakaalam.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Ano po ang pinaka-priority ng pangangailangan nila?

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Depende po sa kanilang mga personnel na hired to conduct such services and through the equipment na kaya nila.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Sapagkat kailangan din po dyan ng radiologist, mga specialization.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: And the criteria is dapat po, they have to show na una-una kailangan nila.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: And they can actually administer the service na inibigay sa nila.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: And then of course,

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: it is a matter po of, kasi pipila din po dito sa first-come, first-served din po sa amin.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: Kung sino po ang mga kapaghingi po ng gano'n.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: So, it's a combination of this.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: If you need them, depende on the priority na kailangan.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: And then the ability nila to train their personnel to handle such equipment.

segments.speaker: PCSO General Manager Melquiades Robles
segments.text: And then yun na nga po is the order po ng pag-re-request nila.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Thank you, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Mr. Chair, I just wanted to make a quick manifestation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: So, nakita naman po natin ng nagagawang magagandang programa po ng ating PCSO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: And with that, everything speaks for itself.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: Nandito naman po sa kanilang report.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: I just wanted to make a manifestation of my full support for the proposed budget ng ating PCSO.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: And hoping that you continue whatever you're doing for the country.

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: And of course,

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos
segments.text: nandito po tayo ang ating House of Representatives to assist in everything that we can

segments.speaker: Rep. Jan "Atty. JP" Padiernos

segments.text: Yun lang po. Maraming salamat po, Mr. Chair.

segments.text: So, it's a good combination between GM and of course, the President, Chairman.

segments.text: Yun lang po. Maraming salamat po.

segments.text: So, wow.

segments.text: One of our next aspiration is to provide the second round sa mga ambulansya po

segments.text: meron po kaming standby ambulance sa aming office.

segments.text: Kung kailangan-kailangan niyo po, call us po and we can provide you.

segments.text: Yun po. Meron ho kami niyan.

segments.text: Pag talagang kailangan-kailangan niyo, tawagan niyo lang.

segments.text: Sana all.

segments.text: So, kung meron din po, nag-aagawan po kasi, GM.

segments.text: So, ayun lang po kung meron po.
